title: Cross-package source-relative imports break nominal error identity and map to -32603 in compiled distribution
evidence: packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts imports JsonRpcMethodNotFoundError and JsonRpcInvalidParamsError from '../../../protocol/src/index.ts' rather than '@durable-zero/protocol'. When executed against compiled @durable-zero/protocol transport (verified against frozen commit dist blob eb9a64afab9232099a9342b8e654daf6a27aa6aa9a49b44f354f3434df61e00d), 'err instanceof JsonRpcInvalidParamsError' evaluates to false due to dual module instances in Node ESM. Executable counterexample in probe-nominal-identity.mjs proved that session/prompt with invalid content returns -32603 instead of -32602, and unmapped method returns -32603 instead of -32601. Parent critically adjudicated and accepted this finding; routed to author fix round 1/5.
impact: Severe public protocol contract regression in production runtime and compiled bundles; all dispatcher validation errors and method-not-found errors are misclassified over the wire as internal errors (-32603).

title: Test suite count discrepancy in author report (claimed 61 tests, actual test runner executed 57 tests)
evidence: Author report claimed 27 protocol conformance tests, 34 capability dispatch tests, and 61 combined tests (repeated in report.json). However, packages/protocol/test/protocol-conformance.test.ts contains exactly 23 test cases (5 in Defect 1, 6 in Defect 2, 9 in Defect 3, 3 in Defect 4). Running both test files via node --test outputs 'tests 57, pass 57', matching junit.xml 'tests 57' and parent testcase node count. Parent critically adjudicated and accepted this finding; routed to author fix round 1/5.
impact: Inaccurate test inventory metrics undermine audit receipts and verification integrity.

title: Dispatcher RED artifact capability-dispatch-red.log is an unlabeled truncated excerpt with manual headers
evidence: The file has manually prepended comment headers and is 7,554 bytes, truncating abruptly after the 4th failure instead of the full ~32,611 byte output for all 34 assertion failures. It lacks an explicit label designating it as an excerpt. Parent verification confirmed a genuine behavioral RED occurred at seq328, but the saved log requires explicit labeling and artifact bounds. Parent critically adjudicated and accepted this finding; routed to author fix round 1/5.
impact: Incomplete RED log creates ambiguity for independent auditors regarding whether execution completed or terminated prematurely.

title: createSessionDispatcher factory omission from @durable-zero/runner root export (Adjudicated non-blocking for Task 4B component)
evidence: packages/runner/src/index.ts does not export ./dispatch/index.ts. Parent adjudication ruling: Task 4B handoff explicitly specified an internal runner/src/dispatch/index.ts factory for the composition root owner to integrate inside runner/src/composition.ts, with composition integration reserved to the entrypoint owner. Since composition.ts is inside runner, it imports ./dispatch/index.ts directly; requiring root package export is outside bounded Task 4B scope and risks circular imports. Reclassified from P1 blocker to pending whole-Task4 composition gate observation.
impact: No blocker on Task 4B component; tracked as an integration verification gate when wiring composition.ts.

title: File line budget exceeded in packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts (300 LOC > 250 LOC Hard Limit)
evidence: packages/runner/src/dispatch/session-dispatcher.ts contains 300 lines of code. AP-019 primary source defines soft 150 / hard 250 LOC with a specific P3 exception for inseparable async pipelines. Extraction of prompt input/options normalizers is permitted without fragmenting business behavior.
impact: Maintainability smell; prompt extraction helpers can be cleanly separated from the method switch without chopping behavior.

title: Numeric conversationId rejected with JsonRpcInvalidParamsError (Source-backed boundary ruling applied)
evidence: session-dispatcher.ts strictly enforces 'typeof params.conversationId === "string"', rejecting numeric values like { conversationId: 1 } with code -32602. Parent source-backed boundary ruling: normalize using existing conversationIdSchema so that Core port receives strings (e.g. String(id)), preserving wire compatibility without rewriting graph/event IDs.
impact: Clients passing numeric conversation IDs (native representation in @earendil-works/pi-durable) will be accepted and coerced to string rather than rejected.
